taken: feat/public-surfaces-p1-shell (card P1, view mode): main.ts split into the view path (index, plus the shared panels and preload-helper chunks it imports) and lazy chunks — the compiler (its own `compiler` chunk, modulepreloaded, not render-blocking), the example sources, the header actions, edit mode (CodeMirror and the source panels), takeoff and the 3D preview. The view path went from 625,306 B (index 192,918 + panels 432,388, the core inside panels) to 9,276 B; the compiler alone is 429,704 B. No 3D marker and no CodeMirror marker in any startup chunk.
retaken: perf/mp5-no-boot-compile (card MP5, ruling MP-D4: a visit pays only for what it uses): the compiler is no longer modulepreloaded by index.html, and a visit on the built-in plan does not compile at boot (the page holds the drawing as the live render draws it, its facts line and its describe()); the compiler and the example sources load on first use or when the browser is idle, never on idle under Save-Data or 2g. The startup set (what index.html loads on every visit) went from 447,460 B on main 6c67c07c (compiler 431,116 + index 12,344 + panels 2,773 + preload-helper 798 + rolldown-runtime 429) to 16,383 B (index 12,812 + panels 2,773 + preload-helper 798), which is now the view path alone; the compiler path (startup set + compiler, loaded by the first use) is 447,928 B (+468 B in index for the lazy boot), under compilerPathBudget. The embed path is unchanged at 436,076 B (embed.html imports the core statically and compiles at once). No number below was raised: the budgets and the P1 sums stand, and the gate now asserts the startup set is the view path with no compiler.
how: npm ci && npm run build && npm run playground:build:only; each size is the byte length of node:zlib gzipSync(file) at the default level, keyed by the file name without its content hash (for reading only: the gates sum them). The startup set is walked (card PG5a): the files dist/index.html names (its module <script src> and every <link rel=modulepreload>) plus every chunk they reach through static imports and re-exports (`import … from`, `import "…"`, `export … from`; never `import()`). The view path is that walk from every root but the compiler; since card MP5 index.html names no compiler, so the startup set is the view path, and the compiler path is the startup set's walk plus the compiler chunk's. Two more walks feed only the forbidden-chunk check: the boot roots, the chunks of the `import()`s main.ts makes on a visit's first use or idle load (./compiler.js, ./examples.js, ./samples.js, ./actions.js), each found among the built entry's dynamic imports; and the embed path, the walk from dist/embed.html's module script and modulepreloads, which also has its own budget. The `gzip` and `compilerGzip` numbers below were taken at P1 over the named files alone, before the walk existed; the growth gate compares the walked compiler path (the startup set at P1) against their sum.
viewBudgetWhy: PS-D5 (docs/plans/public-surfaces/README.md): startup JS without the compiler and the editor is at most 60 KB gzip. A hard ceiling on the view path's sum, not a growth allowance.
compilerPathBudgetWhy: card PG5a: the view path plus the compiler and everything both import statically (since card MP5 loaded on first use, not at startup: 447,928 B there). Measured 446,819 B on the PG5a branch (index 11,703 + panels 2,773 + preload-helper 798 + compiler 431,116 + rolldown-runtime 429); 575,197 B before it, when the compiler imported the jsPDF chunk (128,804 B). 458,000 B leaves 11,181 B (2.5 %) for ordinary core growth, stays under the ceiling the growth gate already set (438,980 + 20,000 = 458,980 B), and trips on any lazy heavyweight leaking in (glTF-Transform ~19,900 B, CodeMirror ~117,500 B, jsPDF ~129,800 B, three.js ~149,000 B). A hard ceiling like viewBudget: crossing it is a deliberate re-take with the reason in the commit. Re-taken on feat/rm1.4-silent-accepts (PR #704): RM1.4 adds five catalogue entries for the new warnings (and the checks that raise them), and the compiler path grows by about 3,010 B gzip, from 455,178 B on main 594ba1c7 (compiler 435,959 + index 14,060 + panels 3,932 + preload-helper 798 + rolldown-runtime 429) to 458,188 B (compiler 438,977 + index 14,052 + panels 3,932 + preload-helper 798 + rolldown-runtime 429), over 458,000. The ceiling is raised by 980 B to 458,980 B, the growth gate's own ceiling (438,980 + 20,000), which this budget stays under; the 2.5 % headroom cannot be restored without re-baselining that gate (gzip/compilerGzip), which is not done here, so 792 B are left. No 3D, editor, GLB or PDF marker is in any chunk of the path; the embed path (445,126 B) stays under its own budget.
embedPathBudgetWhy: card PG5a review: embed.html (the iframe other pages show) imports the core statically, so it walks into the compiler and once carried the same jsPDF leak (measured 565,245 B on main 7ad6fbf1, jsPDF's chunk 128,804 B of it). Measured 436,076 B on the PG5a branch (compiler 431,116 + panels 2,773 + embed 1,281 + one-room 477 + rolldown-runtime 429). 447,000 B leaves 10,924 B (2.5 %) for ordinary core growth, the same headroom as compilerPathBudget, and trips on any lazy heavyweight leaking in (the smallest, glTF-Transform, is ~19,900 B). A hard ceiling: crossing it is a deliberate re-take with the reason in the commit.
growthBudgetWhy: card A8: the 3D chunk is ~150,500 B gzip, so +20,000 B over the sum of every startup chunk (view path and compiler) trips on a leak of an eighth of it, while ordinary core growth (A5's own PR: +299 B) takes dozens of PRs to reach it; see preview3d.spec.ts
